# Khaing Myel Khant

> Full-stack product engineer in Yangon, Myanmar, shipping software end to end - design, build, deploy, operate.

## Summary

I'm a full-stack product engineer with a proven record of designing, building, deploying, and operating end-to-end products. I specialize in AI-assisted engineering, real-time systems, and cost-efficient cloud infrastructure, and I've led cross-functional teams of up to 9 engineers to deliver fintech, edtech, and marketplace platforms at scale.

## Experience

- **SolaraTek (2025 - Present)** - Lead Product Engineer. Lead a cross-functional team of 9 across UI/UX, mobile, full-stack, and DevOps. Ship multi-tenant products: school management, digital wallet, loan management, market price intelligence, and map-centric real estate. Set up AI-assisted engineering workflows and self-hosted open-source tools to cut software costs, and built a custom geospatial system with a proprietary map platform for the real estate product.
- **SSP Ventures (2024 - 2025)** - Built a Google Meet-like video conferencing platform with a custom media server. Full-stack - frontend with Next.js and Tailwind, backend with Express.js and TypeScript; designed the system and cloud architecture.
- **Taungthutada (2021 - 2023)** - Developed and maintained the Taungthutada website UI. Next.js with SSG/SSR/ISR, Sanity CMS, and edge functions for fast page loads.
- **TecXplorer (2024)** - Automated the deployment process for an ERP system, reducing errors, downtime, and deployment time.
- **Nude Society (2021)** - Built the original version of the e-commerce website for a Mandalay-based sneaker retailer with Next.js, React, and TypeScript, using Sanity CMS webhooks for cache revalidation and Algolia search indexing.

## Education

- University of Computer Studies, Mandalay - Bachelor of Computer Technology (Telecommunication and Networks), graduated 2025.
